E1.title: Pyzchiva : EPAR - Public assessment report
E1.text:
Study SB17-1001 is a phase 1 randomised, double-blind, single-dose, parallel group, 3-arm study 
comparing the pharmacokinetic, safety, tolerability and immunogenicity profiles of Pyzchiva, EU-
Stelara and US-Stelara in healthy adult subjects. Subjects received a single dose of 45 mg/0.5 mL of 
either Pyzchiva, EU-approved Stelara, or US-licensed Stelara on Day 1 as an SC injection. According to 
the EMA guidelines, a single-dose study with the lowest therapeutic dose used for patients is 
considered the most adequate design to investigate the differences in target-mediated clearance.
The primary objective of the study was to demonstrate PK similarity of Pyzchiva to both EU-Stelara and
US-Stelara; as well as to demonstrate similarity between EU-Stelara and US-Stelara, in terms of Cmax 
and AUC0-inf. For an EU MA, the comparison between Pyzchiva and EU-Stelara is of primary importance, 
while other comparisons are considered supportive.
Secondary objectives comprised additional PK parameters to support similarity, comparison of safety, 
tolerability and immunogenicity between Pyzchiva and reference products.
The assessment of biosimilarity in terms of PK was based on 90% confidence intervals (CIs) for the 
ratio of the geometric means (Pyzchiva/EU-Stelara) for Cmax and AUC0-inf of the ustekinumab 
concentrations which had to be contained within the bioequivalence limits of 80-125%. The 
equivalence margins used in the study are in line with conventionally used margins for biosimilar 
products. Study objectives are overall adequate for the purpose of PK biosimilarity exercise.
Study SB17-3001 is a randomised, double-blind, multicentre, active control clinical study to compare 
the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of Pyzchiva compared to Stelara in adult patients with 
moderate to severe chronic plaque-type psoriasis (PsO).
Of note, the data lock point of study SB17-3001 was Sep 15, 2022 (when all possible subjects 
completed the Week-28 visit and 103 subjects completed the Week-52 visit). The full data set was 
subsequently submitted by the applicant with the responses, allowing a final conclusion on efficacy.
Study SB17-3001 had the primary objective of evaluating therapeutic equivalence of Pyzchiva
compared to Stelara in the treatment of moderate to severe chronic PsO in adult patients.
The primary efficacy endpoint was percent improvement in Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI)
from Baseline to Week 12 in adult subjects with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis.
Clinical equivalence was demonstrated if the 95% CI for the adjusted mean diﬀerence in percentage 
PASI improvement between test and reference groups is contained within the equivalence margin 
range of [-15%, 15%]. A number of secondary endpoints were also evaluated in SB17-3001, these 
included the measurement of additional eﬃcacy endpoints commonly used in patients with PsO 
(PASI50, PASI75, PASI90, and PASI100) Response rates were evaluated at a number of timepoints 
through to Week 52 (Week 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 40, and 52 ), percent change from baseline in 
PASI at Week 2, 4, 8, 16, 20, 24, 28, 40, and 52. Achievement of Physician’s Global Assessment (PGA) 
response was also assessed at Week 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 40, and 52. A further secondary 
endpoint was the change from baseline in Dermatology Life Quality Index (DLQI) scores at Week 4, 12, 
16, 28, 40, and 52.

You interpret a Korean question for a search system over public regulatory documents on the registered products below. Do not answer the question. Registry descriptions identify studies; never use their numerical results as answers or query terms.

Products (use the code):
- SB17 = Pyzchiva = SB17 (피즈치바, 삼성바이오에피스), Samsung Bioepis
- ABP654 = Wezenla (EU) = Wezlana (US, Canada) = ABP 654 (웨젠라, 웨즐라나, 암젠), Amgen
- CTP43 = Steqeyma = CT-P43 (스테키마, 스테퀘이마, 셀트리온), Celltrion
- BMAB1200 = BMAB1200 = Bmab1200 = Bmab 1200 = BMAB-1200 = Yesintek (), Biocon Biologics
- BAT2206 = BAT2206 = BAT 2206 = BAT-2206 = Usymro = Starjemza (), Bio-Thera Solutions (EU: Gedeon Richter)
Stelara (스텔라라, ustekinumab) is the reference product, not one of the products.

Studies (use the key):
- ST_SB17_1001: SB17 SB17-1001 (study) - phase 1; healthy subjects; comparative PK similarity (SB17 vs EU-Stelara vs US-Stelara) [SB17 1상, SB17 건강인 시험, 피즈치바 PK 시험, 피즈치바 건강인 대상 시험]
- ST_SB17_3001: SB17 SB17-3001 (study) - phase 3; patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis; comparative efficacy, safety and immunogenicity vs EU-Stelara; transition to SB17 after week 28 [SB17 3상, SB17 건선 환자 시험, 피즈치바 3상, 피즈치바 유효성 시험]
- ST_ABP_20190230: ABP654 20190230 (study) - phase 1; healthy adults, 18-45 years, 50-90 kg; comparative PK similarity (ABP 654 vs US-Stelara vs EU-Stelara) [ABP 654 1상, 웨젠라 건강인 시험, 웨젠라 PK 시험, ABP 654 PK 시험]
- ST_ABP_20190232: ABP654 20190232 (study) - phase 3; adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis; comparative efficacy, safety and immunogenicity vs EU-Stelara; re-randomisation (switch to ABP 654) at week 28 [ABP 654 3상, 웨젠라 건선 환자 시험, 웨젠라 3상, 웨젠라 유효성 시험]
- ST_ABP_20200417: ABP654 20200417 (study) - phase 3; patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis; interchangeability (alternating ABP 654 and Stelara) [웨젠라 교체투여 시험, ABP 654 상호교환성 시험]
- ST_CTP43_1_1: CTP43 CT-P43 1.1 (study) - phase 1; healthy male subjects; Part 1: initial safety; Part 2: comparative PK similarity (CT-P43 vs EU-Stelara vs US-Stelara) [CT-P43 1.1, 스테키마 첫 번째 PK 시험, CT-P43 실패한 PK 시험, CT-P43 건강 남성 시험(뉴질랜드)]
- ST_CTP43_1_1_P1: CTP43 CT-P43 1.1 Part 1 (study_part) - phase 1; initial safety, CT-P43 vs EU-Stelara [CT-P43 1.1 Part 1]
- ST_CTP43_1_1_P2: CTP43 CT-P43 1.1 Part 2 (study_part) - phase 1; comparative PK similarity, CT-P43 vs EU-Stelara vs US-Stelara [CT-P43 1.1 Part 2]
- ST_CTP43_1_2: CTP43 CT-P43 1.2 (study) - phase 1; healthy Japanese male subjects, body weight 50-90 kg strata; comparative PK similarity, repeated after CT-P43 1.1 (CT-P43 vs EU-Stelara vs US-Stelara) [CT-P43 1.2, 스테키마 일본인 시험, CT-P43 두 번째 PK 시험, CT-P43 재시험, CT-P43 일본인 건강 남성 시험]
- ST_CTP43_3_1: CTP43 CT-P43 3.1 (study) - phase 3; patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis; comparative efficacy, safety and immunogenicity vs EU-Stelara; switch to CT-P43 at week 16 [CT-P43 3상, 스테키마 건선 환자 시험, 스테키마 3상, 스테키마 유효성 시험]
- ST_CTP43_3_2: CTP43 CT-P43 3.2 (planned_study) - phase 3; patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis; planned interchangeability study (alternating US-Stelara and CT-P43) [CT-P43 3.2, 스테키마 교체투여 시험]
- ST_CTP43_POOLED: CTP43 pooled post hoc analysis of CT-P43 1.1 Part 2 and CT-P43 1.2 (cross_study_analysis) - PK similarity CT-P43 vs EU-Stelara on pooled data [CT-P43 통합 분석, CT-P43 pooled 분석]
- ST_BMAB1200_NHV: BMAB1200 BM12H-NHV-01-G-01 (study) - 
- ST_BMAB1200_PSO: BMAB1200 BM12H-PSO-03-G-02 (study) - 
- ST_BAT2206_002: BAT2206 BAT-2206-002-CR (study) - 
Put a study in studies only when the question names it or describes it clearly enough to pick it out using the registry. Consider the entire sentence, including negation, comparisons, ordinal descriptions, parts and analyses spanning studies. A study number may be a component of a pooled analysis or contextual comparison rather than the target. Do not replace a pooled target with its components. Do not collapse a specifically requested part into its parent.
study_scope: specified for identifiable targets, unspecified when no particular study is requested, ambiguous when several interpretations remain. For ambiguous or unspecified scope, leave studies empty and search broadly.
study_mentions: identify the relevant studies and their roles (target, component of an analysis, context, excluded). These roles are the authoritative semantic selection. studies must list exactly the target keys, never component or context keys. quote must be a verbatim phrase from the Korean question, including enough surrounding text to support the role; it may describe a study without naming its identifier. Do not translate, rewrite or expand an abbreviated study identifier inside a quote. When a phase applies to multiple products, consider every requested product independently; do not select only the product with a unique phase.

Jurisdictions: EU (EMA), US (FDA), CA (Health Canada), JP (PMDA), sponsor (ClinicalTrials.gov or sponsor protocols/SAP). Select only document sources the question requests. A reference product's sourcing region is a comparator, not a document jurisdiction. jurisdiction_mentions assigns regulator/comparator/context roles, with verbatim quotations from the question; regulator means requested document source, including sponsor. Every selected jurisdiction requires a regulator mention. Leave jurisdictions empty when no source is specified. Distinguish an agency from a study's recruitment country.

Document groups to search:
- assessment: regulators' assessment reports (EMA EPAR, FDA multi-discipline review, Health Canada Summary Basis of Decision). Default for questions about study design, PK, immunogenicity, efficacy, safety results and regulators' conclusions.
- decision_summary: short decision summaries and post-authorisation procedural steps.
- label: product information, prescribing information, product monograph (indications, posology, label text).
- quality: manufacturing and product quality reviews.
- other_review: other FDA reviews (labeling, human factors, pediatric).
- correspondence: approval letters, other action letters, administrative correspondence (approval dates, provisional determinations).
- rmp: EU risk management plans.
- protocol, sap: sponsor study protocols and statistical analysis plans (planned design, planned statistical methods).
Choose every group that could contain the answer.

Intent:
- fact_lookup: one product, one fact or result.
- compare_products: the same item across two or more products.
- compare_jurisdictions: how agencies differ for a product.
- regulatory_reasoning: why a regulator concluded or required something.
- document_info: dates, versions, which documents exist.
- out_of_scope: not about these products or their public documents, asks for predictions or recommendations, or asks to reveal redacted content.
Questions about a document's tables or figures, including their printed title,
axes, units, legend, caption and footnotes, are in scope. Use fact_lookup for
their printed contents, or document_info for source identification. A visual
question does not require digitising plotted curves and is not out_of_scope.

english_query: translate the whole question into one natural English question. Keep every part of what is asked. Write product names in English with their code (for example "Steqeyma (CT-P43)"). Copy Latin-script terms, numbers, units and study numbers exactly. Use the glossary's English terms.
keywords: 3 to 8 search terms that name what is asked, plus glossary variants documents may use instead.

Question: SB17-1001 시험에서 PK 동등성 한계(equivalence margin)는?

Copy exactly: SB17-1001, PK, equivalence, margin

Glossary:
- 동등성 한계 = equivalence margin (variants: acceptance range, bioequivalence limits)
